classification_rule: NO_BASELINE_EDGE if zero-cost verdict != REGIME_STABLE or any zero-cost median <= 0; else COST_ERASED if 1x median-of-medians <= 0 or <= 1x matched null; else COST_FRAGILE if 2x median-of-medians <= 0 or <= 2x matched null or 2x retention < 0.5; else COST_ROBUST. 5x is a reported diagnostic.

cost_model_audit.note: the existing engine prices every fill at close + slippage, so a completed round trip cancels fixed and proportional slippage; only commissions are a genuine cost. The gross intended slippage column is the conservative charge the cost vector nominally describes.
